data.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our mission is to provide transparency & access to private markets by building a tech-based platform enabling funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, process-driven Investor Onboarding Manager to join our Operations team at bunch. This role will own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds across multiple markets, especially the Netherlands, the UK, and Germany, by managing documentation, investor communication, KYC/AML pre-checks, and closings. This is an individual contributor role in a growing Investor Onboarding team, reporting to the Investor Onboarding Lead.

How the role contributes to the company's vision

  • Ensure a smooth, compliant, and high-quality onboarding experience for investors by owning onboarding workflows end to end with precision and care

  • Help funds close on time by keeping investor files complete, compliant, and finalised in coordination with fund managers, AML officers, and internal teams

  • Keep onboarding in line with jurisdiction-specific requirements across Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK, including investor qualification, FATCA/CRS, and signing rules

  • Drive consistency and operational excellence by keeping SOPs current and turning edge cases and lessons learned into process improvements

  • Help scale onboarding by identifying inefficiencies and working with our platform partner and Product team to improve the investor experience

Top responsibilities

  • Own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds and SPVs, from new-fund setup to closing

  • Carry out KYC/AML pre-checks for individual and entity investors, including IDs, proof of address, register extracts, UBOs, FATCA/CRS self-certifications, and investor classification

  • Prepare complete files for review by AML officers and UK regulatory hosts, and coordinate with them through to approval

  • Send clear, consolidated document requests to investors and guide them through the process with regular follow-ups

  • Plan and coordinate closings, including signing and counter-signature, and provide internal teams with a complete closing summary

  • Act as the main investor onboarding contact for fund managers and Account Managers on assigned funds, guiding them through the standard process and documenting key decisions in writing

  • Keep SOPs for the relevant workflows up to date, document edge cases, and share clear, actionable feedback with our platform partner and Product team

  • Provide cover for colleagues’ funds during absences and peak periods

What you should bring with you

  • At least 2 years of experience in investor or client onboarding, KYC/KYB, or AML operations, ideally in fund administration, private banking, or fintech

  • Solid KYC/KYB judgement: UBO identification on entity structures, document standards, register checks, and working knowledge of FATCA/CRS and investor classification

  • A strong sense of ownership: seeing work through to completion and raising risks early, together with a proposed way forward

  • High attention to detail: a habit of double-checking work and addressing mistakes openly and quickly

  • Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and precise with investors, and confident in setting expectations with stakeholders

  • Able to stay organised during busy closing periods, manage several closings in parallel, and re-prioritise as needed

  • Comfortable working across multiple tools and systems, including onboarding platforms, e-signature, project management tools, and shared inboxes, and open to using AI tools in daily work

  • A good match with our values: Own it, Aim for impact, Empower others, Always be curious, and Enjoy the ride

  • English fluency required; German at B1–B2 level or above is a plus

  • Nice to have: experience in investor relations or fund/legal operations, or familiarity with private market fund structures

Why you should join bunch

  • Work at the heart of investor operations, gaining firsthand experience in private market processes that support leading investment funds

  • Join a driven, collaborative team that values precision, transparency, and shared ownership of outcomes

  • Make direct impact in a fast-growing company alongside professionals passionate about transforming private market infrastructure

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

  • 4 remote calendar weeks/year

  • 28 days of vacation, 2 company days, plus local public holidays

What your interview journey will look like

  1. Screening Call – with Tahira from our Talent Acquisition team, to get acquainted with bunch and understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  2. Hiring Manager Interview – with Evgenii, our Investor Onboarding Lead, to discuss your experience, how you work, and the role in detail

  3. Case Study – a short, realistic onboarding case, prepared in advance and discussed together, to demonstrate your expertise, way of thinking, and how you communicate your output

  4. Final Interview – with Aylin Üzsal, our VP of Operations, to discuss your journey, your goals, and your overall personal purpose

About bunch

bunch is Europe’s leading tech-enabled fund administrator for VC, PE, and alternative assets. By combining AI-powered automation with deep domain expertise, we provide a single source of truth that replaces outdated, fragmented processes, and enables clients to master the entire fund lifecycle.

Private markets are experiencing unprecedented growth; with alternative assets projected to reach $40 trillion by the end of the decade. To power this growth, we have raised €22.8 million to date—including our $15.5M Series A in July 2024—and are accelerating our mission to build the backbone of private markets in Europe.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Berlin, bunch has expanded to Amsterdam, London, and Luxembourg, now supporting over 500 investment structures, 150 fund and asset managers, and more than 10,000 institutional investors. As we prepare for our next stage of growth, we are looking for ambitious talent to continue redefining this financial category.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

data.title: Senior HR Business Partner (f/m/d)
data.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time.

Your Role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it.

This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work.

People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building.

A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it.

*This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required.

What you will own in your first year

  • The people agenda for your client groups. How the teams are structured, where the next leaders come from, and which roles the business cannot afford to lose.

  • The next performance and calibration cycle in your areas, from manager preparation through to the conversations that follow.

  • The career framework for the business areas you support. Our company-wide framework sets the levels and the principles. You build the specific version underneath it with your leaders, so that a mechanical engineer and an electrical engineer can each see what growth looks like in their own discipline.

  • Manager capability in your groups. By the end of the year, your leaders set clearer expectations and have the difficult conversation earlier than they do today.

What You'll Do

Most weeks start with a leader and a problem that is not yet well defined. A team that has doubled and stopped delivering. A strong engineer who is struggling as a manager. Two groups that both believe they own the same work. You ask enough questions to find what is underneath, bring options with a recommendation, and stay with the decision until it has landed.

Alongside that you will:

  • Coach managers on expectations, direct feedback and conversations they would rather postpone.

  • Handle employee relations cases with care and sound judgment, within German employment law.

  • Work with Talent Acquisition on hiring priorities and with People Operations on everything from contract type to exit, so leaders get one joined-up answer.

  • Use people data to show leaders what is happening in their teams and what you would do about it.

Priorities move here, and some processes are still being built. You will often be the person building them.

What You Bring

  • Experience as an HR Business Partner in a deep-tech or engineering-heavy company while it was growing fast.

  • Something you built yourself. A performance process, a leveling framework, compensation bands. We will ask what you personally designed, what you would do differently, and what happened after rollout.

  • Strong German employment law and GDPR, plus a working knowledge of People Operations, including how contract types and payroll deadlines shape a decision.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Based in or near Darmstadt, or ready to relocate.

The leaders you will work with are engineers. They respond to a precise question and a clear recommendation backed by evidence, and they notice quickly when either is missing. If that sounds like a room you enjoy, you will do well here.

It helps if you have seen both a well-run large company and a scale-up, or have partnered with technical and scientific leaders before.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary and stock options, so you hold a stake in what we build.

  • A company contribution of 20% on top of your own payments into a private pension plan, plus loyalty incentives.

  • 30 days of vacation.

  • A mobility budget through NAVIT for public transport, car sharing or taxi, and access to gyms and studios across Europe through Wellhub.

  • A canteen with daily lunch in Darmstadt, and the laptop and equipment of your choice from day one.

  • A seat close to the leadership team, in a People function that is still being shaped.

data.title: Laser Architect - Beam Smoothing
data.description:
Summary
We are looking for a Senior Laser Architect to take ownership of beam-smoothing technology within our laser-driven fusion programme. You will work in the Laser Division to connect smoothing performance with science requirements and laser system design, so that beam quality and system reliability support our fusion energy goals.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the beam-smoothing roadmap, from concept through deployment and continuous improvement.

  • Translate science and system requirements into beam-smoothing and laser-system specifications.

  • Guide the design and optimisation of smoothing approaches for uniformity, contrast and focal-spot quality, across coherent and incoherent techniques.

  • Assess how smoothing choices affect the wider laser and facility architecture, balancing performance, complexity, risk and cost.

  • Work with modelling, experimental and engineering teams to turn results into design decisions.

  • Support technology selection and supplier engagement for smoothing-related hardware and diagnostics.

  • Set design standards and provide technical direction and mentoring to the beam-smoothing team.

Required qualifications

  • PhD or equivalent experience in physics, optics, photonics, applied physics, electrical engineering or a related field.

  • Significant hands-on experience with high-power or high-energy laser systems, in research or industry.

  • Solid understanding of beam smoothing and beam quality, including coherence, speckle, propagation and focal-spot formation.

  • Experience designing and analysing experiments on laser performance or beam quality.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and translating physics needs into engineering requirements.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with laser-driven fusion or inertial confinement fusion programmes.

  • Experience with modelling tools for beam propagation and smoothing.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering practices such as requirements flow-down, verification and trade studies.

  • Experience working with vendors on optical components or beam-conditioning hardware.

Personal attributes

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to weigh trade-offs between smoothing, efficiency, reliability and facility performance.

  • Clear communicator, able to turn complex physics into decisions.

  • Collaborative, hands-on approach.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

Works closely with: laser architects, systems engineering, target physics, diagnostics, controls, operations and external partners.

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

Within easy reach of London, with travel for events across EMEA and APAC.

If you know how to fill a room and keep an event running when the plan changes, you already have the skills we care about. This could be your first job in tech.

You'll work closely with @Brittany Mitchell, our Lead Events Manager. Brittany came to Gorgias straight from hotel events and learned the tech side on the job. You'll have Brittany as your mentor, with a training plan Brittany built for this role and your own events to run.

What you'll do

  • Own the EMEA and APAC events calendar. Help decide which conferences are worth showing up for and when we'd rather host our own workshop or dinner. You'll often have more than one event in motion.

  • Build the guest list with Sales, then get people to say yes. Reach out to ecommerce founders and customer experience leads, and make introductions when they're in the room.

  • Give partners a reason to get involved. Pitch a sponsorship, work with an agency on a dinner, or pull together a panel with speakers who have something useful to say.

  • Make the day run. Book the venue, negotiate with vendors, watch the budget, and keep speakers and partners on schedule. When something changes on-site, you're the person who figures out what to do next.

  • Stick around for the follow-up. Work with Sales to see which conversations turned into opportunities, then use that to decide what to repeat and what to skip.

Who you'll bring together

Gorgias helps ecommerce brands run customer support and answer shoppers' questions. Think Boody, the Australian apparel brand that uses Gorgias to handle everyday order and shipping questions, or Kulani Kinis, the Sydney swimwear brand that uses Gorgias and Loop to make returns and exchanges easier. The people you'll invite are the ones running those kinds of teams and stores.

A look at what we've put on

  • Gorgias Connect London: A full day at Labs House in Holborn. PostPilot, Okendo and Domaine joined us for a panel on how AI-powered support can help bring shoppers back. The agenda also featured customer experience leaders from Symprove and The Diamond Store. See photos from London.

  • Gorgias Connect Paris: A smaller room at Royale, with a seminar downstairs and drinks upstairs so guests could keep talking after the sessions. See photos from Paris.

What you bring

You've helped run real events, and you can tell us what you owned, what went sideways, and how you handled it. You're comfortable reaching out to people you haven't met, and you keep track of the details when several things are moving at once.

Hotel events, venues, agencies, or another events background? We'd love to hear from you. You don't need SaaS or ecommerce experience.

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

data.title: Application Security Engineer
data.description:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer, healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

Role Purpose

Genomic data is some of the most sensitive data there is, and our customers trust us with it. As Senior Application Security Engineer on Mystra, you'll own application security end-to-end across multi-tenant, trillion-row-scale, AI-enabled data platforms.

You'll lead threat modelling and design review with product teams, build the tooling and patterns that make secure codet, and find and fix the vulnerabilities that slip through. You'll do it with security-focused AI tooling, steered by your own expert judgement and intuition, to keep Genomics secure against state-of-the-art threats.

A Day in the Life

  • Leading threat modelling and design reviews for new products and infrastructure, and defining the security invariants every team builds against: tenant isolation, authentication and authorisation, secrets, least privilege, and trust boundaries

  • Building the libraries, patterns, and CI/CD guardrails that make the secure way the easy way, and deciding what is enforced versus advised

  • Building and tuning AI tooling for code analysis, triage, and remediation, and deciding where its output can be trusted and where it must be verified

  • Hunting for vulnerabilities through code review, testing, and proof-of-concept exploits, then running the disclosure programme and driving every finding through to a verified fix

  • Securing our agentic and AI surfaces, from prompt injection and tool boundaries to delegated credentials and tenant-scoped access, and proving the controls hold under adversarial testing

  • Working as an embedded, trusted partner to product teams, SRE, detection and response, the data platform team, and the MystraAI / ML team, unblocking rather than gating

Who You Are

  • Experience within application security in production. You've found and fixed exploitable bugs in software you were responsible for, through threat modelling, secure design, code review, and proof-of-concept exploitation across web services, APIs, and data-serving interfaces. Triaging scanner output doesn't count

  • Production-quality software engineering in at least one mainstream language (such as Python, Go, or TypeScript), and you can read several. You've built and operated security or developer tooling in CI/CD pipelines, such as static and dependency analysis, secrets detection, or policy-as-code, and engineers actually adopted it

  • Hands-on depth securing multi-tenant systems on a major cloud. We run on AWS (RDS, EC2, S3, EKS, Batch), and comparable GCP or Azure depth transfers. You know tenant isolation, IAM and least privilege, secrets management, Kubernetes and container security, and the trust boundaries between services

  • Daily use of frontier AI models for code analysis, vulnerability triage, remediation drafting, and research, with sharp judgement about where they're reliable and where they mislead. You've built or tuned LLM-driven tooling rather than only used a chat interface, and you understand the attack surface it introduces

  • Experience running, or being core to, a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty programme and the remediation lifecycle behind it, covering severity, prioritisation, SLAs, root cause, and systemic fixes. You've also worked application-layer incidents alongside detection and response, using security telemetry and SIEM data as evidence

  • Risk-led judgement. You know which designs need deep review, which findings matter and which are noise, and you make accepted risk explicit so leadership can decide with open eyes

  • Clear communication. You explain risk and trade-offs precisely to engineers, product, and leadership, write guidance people actually use, and mentor others to grow security capability across teams

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Reward: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure market-aligned compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Hybrid Working

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

If this opportunity excites you, apply now!

We are dedicated to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Genomics politely requests no contact from recruitment agencies. We do not accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies nor accept the fees associated with them.

data.title: Head of Supply Chain
data.description:
The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Supply Chain to take ownership of how Lumai sources, manages and receives the components that go into our systems. As we move from prototypes to multi-node system deployments and towards our next-generation product, the volume and complexity of what we buy is growing quickly. You will take this work on from our engineering team, allowing them to focus on design and development. In the near term, you will be responsible for sourcing and delivering the components for a major system deployment, working closely with engineering to keep it on schedule and within budget. Alongside this, you will build the supplier relationships, parts management and processes that Lumai will need as it moves towards production.

This is an early role in a growing operations function. You will report into operations leadership, and there is a clear opportunity for the role to grow into a more strategic position as Lumai scales.

What You Will Do

Sourcing and delivery

  • Take ownership of the sourcing of the bill of materials for current system builds, working with engineering to confirm requirements and what is still to be sourced

  • Identify long-lead and single-source items, and put mitigation plans in place

  • Obtain quotes, place and expedite purchase orders, and track deliveries against project plans

  • Work within Lumai's procurement and finance processes

  • Track materials spend against project budgets

Supplier development

  • Identify, assess and qualify suppliers across electronics, PCBs, mechanical parts, contract manufacturing and assembly, and optical components

  • Develop sourcing strategy for future products – single versus dual sourcing, and supplier risk

  • Negotiate pricing, NDAs and supply agreements, working with legal

  • Secure capacity and allocation for constrained parts ahead of volume

  • Build cost models that inform product costing and cost reduction

  • Support new product introduction as designs move from prototype to production

Parts, BoM and lifecycle management

  • Establish Lumai's parts and BoM management process – part numbering, approved manufacturer and supplier lists, and revision and change control – with engineering

  • Introduce a preferred parts list and influence component selection early in design to reduce supply and obsolescence risk

  • Monitor product change and end-of-life notices, and manage the response – last-time buys, qualifying alternates, and flagging redesign needs

  • Maintain a view of supply risk across the BoM

Logistics, stores and quality

  • Manage inbound and outbound logistics, import and customs, and support export control requirements on outbound shipments

  • Set up goods-in, incoming inspection, stores and inventory control appropriate to Lumai's stage

  • Select and run lightweight tools for parts, BoM and inventory management that will scale with the company

  • Define supplier quality expectations, track supplier performance, and manage non-conformances and returns

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

  • At least three years' experience in supply chain, procurement or operations within a hardware company – such as electronics, semiconductors or data centre systems

  • Hands-on experience sourcing components, from quotation through to delivery

  • Practical experience of BoM management, part lifecycle and component obsolescence

  • Experience setting up or improving supply chain processes and tools

  • Confident negotiating with suppliers and building long-term supplier relationships

  • Comfortable doing transactional work day to day while building strategy and process for the longer term

  • Able to work closely with engineers and understand technical specifications

Desirable

  • Experience taking hardware from prototype to production, including working with contract manufacturers

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment

  • Knowledge of optical, photonic or optoelectronic components

  • Familiarity with import, customs and export control processes

  • Experience with ERP, PLM or inventory management systems

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time. Our first optical computing server is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

Today we run car parks for shopping centres, councils, the NHS, hotels and more, and we're scaling fast, with high standards, low ego and never at the expense of fairness.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Revenue Operations to own HubSpot and all of Hozah's market and client data. You'll keep that data accurate and clean, use it to help us grow existing accounts, and produce the reporting the business runs on.

It's a hands-on role. Our board and leadership team set strategy using this data and use it to measure whether that strategy is working. If the data is wrong, the decisions are wrong.

You'll report to our Chief Growth Officer and lead a Revenue Operations Executive, who joins at the same time. The role is based in Croydon, next to East Croydon Station, working hybrid with at least three office days a week. Target start: January 2027.

What You'll Own

  • Market data. Our market and prospect data, built from multiple sources and kept accurate, current and compliant.

  • Client data. Accurate client data, and the analysis that helps us grow existing accounts.

  • HubSpot. Structure, pipelines, permissions, integrations and automation across sales, client success and marketing, with rules that stop bad data getting in.

  • Leads and accounts. Lead definitions, scoring and routing, and how accounts are allocated across the sales team.

  • Reporting. Full-funnel and pipeline reporting from one set of definitions, and what each initiative and campaign produced.

  • Team. Leading a Revenue Operations Executive, training new starters and using automation and AI to cut manual work.

This role has no individual sales quota.

Who We're Looking For

  • Expert, hands-on HubSpot skills: you can build and fix anything, from workflows, automation and data structures to validation, permissions, reporting and integrations.

  • Strong data skills: you've built and managed account and contact data at scale from several sources, kept it clean with checks that stop bad data coming back, and turned it into reporting people trust.

  • Confident, practical use of AI to cut manual work and improve quality, with sensible checks.

  • Clear communication: you explain what the numbers mean to senior people, get changes adopted, challenge requests constructively and lead a junior colleague.

Useful but not essential:

  • Experience building or transforming a revenue operations function.

  • Experience with lead management and with measuring what campaigns and initiatives produced.

  • SQL, scripting or APIs.

  • Experience with data enrichment and research tools.

  • Working knowledge of UK GDPR, PECR and legitimate interest for B2B data.

  • Experience in a scaling B2B business, ideally selling to property owners, managers or multi-site organisations.

Parking industry experience is not required.

What You Get In Return

  • Ownership of HubSpot and all our market and client data, building on data and systems already in place.

  • A Revenue Operations Executive reporting to you.

  • A direct line to our Chief Growth Officer, with work the board uses to set strategy.

  • Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Croydon office, next to East Croydon Station, and the rest from home.

Hiring Process

  1. A 45–60 minute introductory Teams call with our Head of Talent Acquisition.

  2. A 75 minute structured Teams interview with our Chief Growth Officer.

  3. An approximately two-hour practical assessment/interview at our Croydon office covering HubSpot, automation and data quality, market data and process design, and interpreting data, using fictional information. No take-home assignment.

  4. References before an offer.

data.title: Head of Security
data.description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role

We're seeking a Head of Security to join our team in London and own the security of Basecamp Research: our data, our models, our locations and our people.

We hold one of the most valuable proprietary biological datasets in the world and the models trained on it, and we operate labs, field expeditions and partnerships across more than 30 countries. Our proprietary data and IP is incredibly powerful therefore we have a duty to our investors, employees, governments and partners to do everything in our power to protect it and use it for positive outcomes. Our security function will take the lead on cyber security and AI safety, and we have strong technical controls across our estate, working with governmental and commercial partners. We now need a new leader to build on our security foundations and develop them into a complete, mature security programme.

This is a hands-on role with a wide remit: cyber and infrastructure security with the platform team, AI and agentic security across the company, and personnel, insider risk, physical and travel security with the People and Operations teams

What you'll own

  • Security strategy. Threat model, roadmap, policies, security culture and reporting to leadership.

  • Cyber and infrastructure security. Vulnerability management, network, cloud and on-prem hardening, supply chain risk, incident response.

  • AI security. Agentic systems, isolated research environments, model and data protection and AI safety risks across the company.

  • People and physical security. Insider risk, personnel security, investigations, threat intelligence, office and lab security, and duty of care for staff in the field.

  • Certifications and providers. Certifications like ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, partner due diligence, and external security vendors.

About you

  • Experience building or leading a security programme against sophisticated, well-resourced adversaries, in government, defence, protective security or a targeted company, with a working knowledge of threat actors and their tactics.

  • Hands-on. You will personally run vulnerability management, review infrastructure designs, lead incident and crisis response and write policy.

  • Strong technical depth across identity, endpoint, network, cloud and on-prem infrastructure and application security, working with engineers and researchers to secure lab and research environments without slowing the science.

  • Experience running training and awareness programmes to foster a positive culture of shared responsibility in relation to personnel, insider risk and physical security that protect IP while remaining proportionate and trusted by staff.

  • You take responsibility for the outcome. If a problem requires learning something new or working outside your usual area, you do it.

  • Discretion, judgement and personal integrity. You will handle sensitive matters that require pragmatism coupled with a strong moral compass. Collaborative and low ego. In a small team everyone depends on what you build.

Nice to have

  • Experience with national security or cybersecurity bodies

  • Experience taking a company through ISO 27001, and familiarity with ISO 42001, ISO 31030 and UK government security frameworks.

  • Experience with the security of ML research environments, AI safety and agentic systems.

  • Experience running travel risk programmes for staff in high-risk locations.

  • Experience in life sciences, including lab environments and regulated data.

What we offer in return

Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics.

Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our top talent, we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

Do you want to join our team? Then we'd love to hear from you.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

data.description:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on:

  • Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

  • Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

  • Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

  • Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

  • Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

  • Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production.

  • Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services.

data.description:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

data.title: Senior Product Designer
data.description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable. You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design.

You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.

The ideal candidate

  • 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup

  • Strong mobile app and web experience

  • Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence

  • Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right

  • Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk

  • AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster

  • Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback

  • Bonus:

    • Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override)

    • Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools

    • Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty

    • UX writing

What you'll be doing

  • Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction

  • Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build

  • Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions

  • Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer

  • Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success

  • Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself

  • Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work

  • Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own

Our design principles

  1. Simplicity wins

    1. If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless.

  2. Evidence over ego

    1. We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined based on real user behavior.

  3. Trust is our best feature

    1. Finance is built on trust. Every design decision should reinforce transparency, security, and user confidence. We prove we care by helping users make financial decisions that empower them.

Interview Process

  • CV screening

  • An introductory call with someone from the Talent Team and/or hiring manager

  • A take-home exercise to complete in your own time

  • Task debrief with members of the design team (45 mins)

  • Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):

    • VP Product & Design

    • Engineering team members

    • Final round interview with our CPO

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our Glassdoor Reviews and blog!

About the Role

Zable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident.

You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them.

AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Alert Triage & Monitoring

  • Triage and investigate alerts across our SIEM, EDR, identity and cloud tooling, taking escalations from our MSSP’s first-line team.

  • Reduce false positives and alert fatigue by tuning detection rules, thresholds and suppressions.

  • Utilise AI and automation to speed up triage, enrichment and response, and to remove repetitive manual work from the analyst workflow.

2. Incident Command & Response

  • Command security incidents, coordinating technical response, decision-making and communications across Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders. Give clear, timely updates to executives during live incidents.

  • Lead or support technical investigation and containment across endpoint, identity and cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, including incidents involving AI use, such as prompt injection, or credentials exposed through AI-generated code.

  • Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls.

  • Take part in the out-of-hours on-call rota.

3. Operational Reporting & Assurance

  • Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes.

  • Maintain accurate incident records and evidence in our incident management platform to support audit and assurance activity.

  • Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven incident command: Demonstrable experience leading significant security incidents as Incident Commander or lead responder, from declaration to resolution and review. You can describe incidents you have run, the decisions you made and what you changed afterwards.

  • Technical investigation skills: Solid hands-on SOC/DFIR experience, including log analysis, endpoint and identity investigation, and cloud incident response in AWS or GCP.

  • AI fluency: You understand how AI use creates security risk, including data exposure, agent misuse and AI-assisted attacks, and you can investigate and contain incidents that involve it.

  • AI-first ways of working: You already use AI and automation to speed up your own work, whether in investigation, enrichment, detection engineering or reporting, and you can judge when to trust the output and when to check it.

  • Composure and influence: You stay calm and structured under pressure, and can direct engineers and senior stakeholders without formal authority over them.

  • Communication: You can brief a senior leader in plain language during a live incident, and write a post-incident report that an engineer, an auditor and a board member can each use.

  • Pragmatism: You understand that security supports a business moving quickly, and you balance risk, speed and proportionality in your decisions.

  • Regulated environment awareness (desirable): Experience in financial services or another regulated sector, including incident reporting and evidence expectations.

  • Certifications (desirable, not required): GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or equivalent practical experience.

Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.

  • Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation

  • Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do

  • Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

  • Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

  • Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

  • Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

  • Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

  • Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

What we're looking for

Essential

Direct Marketing is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Marketing to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment. Addressed direct mail is the core today, and you’ll have the scope to extend into other formats.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct marketing roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build and extend a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct marketing, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Commercial ownership: you build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, and judge results on a marginal CAC basis rather than vanity metrics.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Zable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Zable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

data.description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

In six years, Zable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Zable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Zable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:
