  2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

  3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

About the role

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Own the mobile test strategy:

  • Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

  • Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

  • Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

  • 2-3+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Comfortable with mobile E2E automation, or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly.

Desirable:

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Our tech stack

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

General Accountant - Accounts Payable
Acquisition Operations
data.description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.

Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.

You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

 

What you'll build

Horizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days)

  • Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it.

  • Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call.

  • Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly.

Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9)

  • Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks.

  • Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing.

  • Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters.

Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond)

  • Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel.

  • Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously.

  • Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it.

 

Why this role

  • Impact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days.

  • Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. You get frontier AI tools, our data platform and engineers who build with you.

  • Direct line to leadership: you'll present growth performance every week and shape decisions at company level.

  • A rare combination: strategy, data, marketing and AI engineering in a single seat. The steepest learning curve we can offer.

  • A path that grows with the system: from operator to architect to leader of growth automation at Zefir.

 

Who you are

  • Top-tier problem solver: 2 to 6 years at a top strategy consultancy (BCG, McKinsey, Bain...), in Growth, Ops or Strategy at a high-growth tech company, or both. You structure messy problems in minutes and you get the math right the first time.

  • Builder at heart: you have already built something real: a model, a tool, an automation, an AI agent, a side project. SQL is second nature; Python is a strong plus. You'd rather prototype in an afternoon than debate for a week.

  • Commercial instinct: you think in revenue, not in vanity metrics. You're curious about why people click, book and buy, and you know when fewer leads is good news.

  • Systems thinker: when you see a task done twice, you design the system that removes it. You care about guardrails, feedback loops and what happens when things break.

  • Ownership and clarity: you hold a high bar, move fast and own outcomes. You write crisp updates that start with the number, the cause and the action.

  • Languages: fluency in French and English is required.

  • What we don't require: years of media buying or a marketing title. We hire for slope, not intercept: if you learn fast and build relentlessly, we'll teach you the rest.

 

Hiring process

  • 30-min call with our Talent Lead

  • 30-min interview with the hiring manager

  • 60-min live case on real (anonymised) funnel data. AI is allowed in part of the case: we want to see how you use it.

  • 15-min coffee chat with our RevOps lead and 45-min Behavioral interview with our CoFounder, then references


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Manage integrations with the customer's ecommerce tech stack; explore feasibility of custom integration paths and troubleshoot proactively using available technical resources and AI tools.

  • Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers.

  • Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI Agent, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly. Proactively uses tools like Claude to improve your own efficiency.

  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

  • Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn.

  • Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge.

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

data.title: Senior Engineering Team Lead
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. 

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills.

You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users.

As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team.

Engineering:

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure.

  • Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows.

  • Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development.

  • Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery.

  • Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use.

  • Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions.

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity.

  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution.

Management:

  • Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

  • Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals.

  • Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments.

  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members.

  • Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills.

  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards.

  • Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter.

  • Data Volume: Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements.

  • Technical Stack: Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus.

  • Coding Skills: You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus.

  • Data Modeling: Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus.

  • Data Transformation: Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus.

  • Engineering Leadership: Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level.

  • People Management: Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team.

  • Communication: Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off);

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years;

  • Profit-sharing scheme

  • Healthcare plan with excellent coverage;

  • Lunch Vouchers;

  • Mental Health support;

  • Flexible remote working policy;

  • Regular team-life event / activity;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. 

OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition,

  • Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer

  • Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering, 

  • A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer. 

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.

Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin.

Tour-opérateur réceptif (DMC) indépendant, nous concevons et organisons des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités en famille, en liberté ou accompagnés.

Du Canal du Midi aux Pyrénées, en passant par les Cévennes, l'Aubrac et la Catalogne, nous invitons nos voyageurs à découvrir les territoires autrement, à leur rythme et au plus près de la nature.

Contexte de la mission

ImaginePartners recherche un Product Owner Open Source pour accompagner un acteur du secteur ferroviaire dans l’ouverture d’un logiciel de signalisation. Vous piloterez la préparation de l’ouverture et construirez une feuille de route commune aux versions interne et open source. Préparer l’ouverture du logiciel

  • Définir avec les équipes techniques le périmètre du code et de la documentation à publier. Coordonner les validations juridiques, de confidentialité et de sécurité.

Suivre les contributions et les publications si l’option est activée

  • Préparer les versions publiques et leurs notes de version, tenir à jour la feuille de route publique et animer les échanges avec la communauté.

  • Suivre les écarts entre les deux versions du logiciel et coordonner l’analyse de leurs impacts sur les exigences, les essais et la qualification.

Atouts

data.title: Brand Designer
data.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define.

What you'll do

  • Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard
  • Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room
  • Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery
  • Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand
  • Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products

Requirements

Two things matter most:

Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type.

Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company.

Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Frontend Experiences
Founding Product Manager - Claap
data.description:
we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO.

About Claap

Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams.

What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work.

This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible.

Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade.

We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM.

As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one.

You will work with Robin on three big topics:

- In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching.

- Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app.

- Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics.

The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing).

Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached.

Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together.

The PM at Claap wears different hats

- A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed

- A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance

- An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe

- A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation

- A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it

What you are not

- A Project Manager who only talks about methodologies and frameworks

- A Product Owner writing super detailed 4-page tickets for devs

- A feature factory building every custom request an enterprise prospect asks for

- The "Notion docs & meetings person" with no real impact on our users and the business

- A "yes man" for every idea and suggestion people bring to you

- A people manager looking for a team to run: this role is hands-on

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

- Developed a deep understanding of Claap, the call intelligence market and our product vision

- Built relationships with Claap users, from sales reps to the admins of our largest accounts

- Mapped the enterprise requirements that slow down or block our deals, and shipped the first ones

- Identified the key closing jobs to be done and shipped first iterations with your squad

- Won the trust of your squad, Robin, and the Sales and CS teams

Within 12 months you will have

- Made Claap truly enterprise-ready: governance, settings and configuration are no longer a reason we lose a deal

- Made Claap a must-have in our users' closing workflow, with measurable adoption and retention

- Positively impacted the company's revenue through solutions you've helped launch

- Influenced the Claap product vision by suggesting transformative developments

What's in it for you?

- A founding role: you're the first PM at Claap, with real ownership on a fast-growing AI product and a direct line to the founders

- Helping thousands of sales professionals close more deals

- A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action

- Opportunity to shape our company's direction

- Potential to establish yourself as an expert in AI for sales

Preferred experience

Must have

- You have 5+ years of experience in product. Scale-up experience is highly preferred.

- You have a strong academic background (business school, engineering school or equivalent) and/or experience in top-tier companies.

- You are a hands-on PM: you are an individual contributor today, or you led product at an early-stage startup.

- You have a real taste and curiosity for AI and tech, ideally with features or agents you've launched end to end.

- You have a big bias for action: you are a "débrouillard" and understand the value of speed & execution.

- You have strong communication skills.

- You speak French and English. This is non-negotiable: most of our enterprise accounts are French-speaking.

- You have a strong pragmatism.

- You have a solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms.

- You have a strong business acumen.

Nice to have

- You have experience in enterprise or upper mid-market SaaS (permissions, admin, SSO, security reviews).

- You have worked on sales tech, revenue intelligence or tools used by sales teams.

- You have Growth, Revenue Operations or Sales experience.

- You know how to wireframe designs.

- You are humble and look for clues that you are wrong.

- You are curious, always asking questions and learning new stuff.

Additional Information

- Competitive salary + profit sharing

- Where you live and work is totally up to you: we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷

- Profit sharing: when lempire wins, all team members share the profits

- Alan Blue: comprehensive 100% premium medical coverage for you and your family

- Swile Meal Tickets: daily meal tickets to fuel productivity

- Navigo Card: 100% covered Navigo card

- Full-remote work setup: a well-funded home office budget

- Gear: a laptop + the tools and equipment you need for your job

- Team building: we all meet once a year at really cool places around the world

Recruitment process

- Interview with Victoire, our Talent Acquisition Manager

- Interview with Robin, Claap co-founder and CEO

- Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Robin and Pierre

- Team fit

- Interview with Charles, our CEO

- Reference Check

- Offer

How to apply

Include a short note (200 words max) on an AI feature or agent you shipped end to end. It's the hardest thing to read on a CV, so we screen for it from day one.

data.description:
À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue.

  • Un impact direct : la qualité de l'équipe commerciale française dépendra de ce que vous construisez.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter la Lexroom Sales Academy en France : concevoir et animer des programmes de formation récurrents (onboarding, ramp-up, formation avancée), avec objectifs, contenus, calendrier et indicateurs de succès.

  • Gérer l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues commerciales : première semaine et deux premiers mois de ramp-up, en coordonnant agendas, supports, intervenants internes et exercices pratiques.

  • Animer vous-même les modules de formation : méthodologie de vente, discovery, démos, traitement des objections, négociation, gestion du pipeline, avec role-plays, coaching sur les appels et feedback structuré.

  • Maintenir les contenus à jour : playbooks, scripts, templates et supports de l'Academy, en phase avec l'évolution du produit, du marché et des performances de l'équipe. Transformer les succès internes (appels, emails, séquences, deals complexes) en ressources de formation réutilisables.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec les Sales Managers et les AE pour que la formation se traduise concrètement dans le pipeline, les appels et les démos.

  • Aligner l'Academy France avec les initiatives globales et adapter au marché français les best practices déjà éprouvées en Italie.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience en management commercial, sales enablement ou gestion de projet en environnement B2B (idéalement SaaS, tech ou conseil).

  • Solide mindset PMO : capacité à transformer des besoins en plans structurés, aligner les parties prenantes, tenir les délais, livrer et mesurer l'impact.

  • À l'aise aussi bien en animation (formations, ateliers, role-plays) que dans le travail de détail sur les process, les contenus et les métriques.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration transverse.

  • Très opérationnel : vous ne vous contentez pas de concevoir des programmes, vous participez aux appels, analysez les chiffres et itérez vite.

  • Français natif, anglais courant (équipes internes internationales).

  • Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération fixe: 80 k€ brut annuel + variable sur objectifs

  • Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être)

  • Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris

Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

data.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE ROLE

Rattaché(e) à la Head of Design, vous intervenez sur la création des collections homme et femme, jersey, bain et flou show, des recherches d'images jusqu'au suivi des prototypes en normalisation.
Ce poste couvre à la fois la création et le développement produit : vous travaillez en lien avec les usines partenaires et participez au bien aller de chaque pièce.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Réaliser les recherches iconographiques et construire les boards de collection
  • Mener les recherches de volumes, de finitions et de graphismes
  • Réaliser les visuels sur Photoshop et les maquettes
  • Assurer le sourcing matière
  • Établir les fiches de lancement et suivre les corrections de prototypes
  • Réaliser les dessins techniques
  • Participer aux essayages
  • Accompagner les pièces jusqu'à la normalisation, en lien avec les usines
 
 
VOTRE PROFIL

Vous justifiez d'une première expérience d'environ 2 ans en tant que designer junior, idéalement sur le jersey et/ou le flou.

Vous avez également :

  • Une sensibilité forte pour le bien aller du vêtement, avec un attrait pour le flou et le travail en 3D
  • La maîtrise de la suite Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et une aisance en dessin technique
  • Un esprit autonome, débrouillard et force de proposition
  • La capacité à prendre rapidement des automatismes et à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle
  • L'envie d'évoluer au sein d'un studio créatif exigeant
 
 
Le poste est basé à Paris dans le 8ème arrondissement

Présentation de Theodo

Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Le groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leurs transformations digitales en mobilisant des expertises complémentaires en Design, Web, Mobile, Data & IA, Cloud et Serverless.

Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.

Dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution, Theodo s’appuie sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une approche orientée résultats et une exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de satisfaction client.

Contexte du recrutement

Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.

Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.

Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels. Ton rôle sera de fluidifier la prise de décision, de structurer les initiatives prioritaires et de garantir leur bonne exécution.

Tes missions

Ton objectif : démultiplier l’impact de Noémie Parker et contribuer directement à la performance de Theodo France, en apportant un appui stratégique et opérationnel, tout en garantissant la bonne coordination des parties prenantes.

1. Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie

  • Participer à la définition des priorités stratégiques de Theodo France à 12 mois, en lien avec Noémie Parker et les équipes de direction.

  • Analyser les leviers de croissance, les enjeux de performance et les opportunités de développement.

  • Préparer les revues stratégiques et contribuer à la formalisation des plans d’action.

  • Transformer les orientations stratégiques en objectifs clairs, mesurables et partagés par les équipes.

2. Accompagner la direction dans le pilotage opérationnel

  • Préparer et animer les réunions de direction : définition de l’ordre du jour, priorisation des sujets, suivi des décisions et des actions.

  • Structurer les processus de prise de décision et assurer le suivi des priorités.

  • Anticiper les points de blocage et faciliter la résolution des sujets transverses.

  • Organiser les temps forts de la direction : séminaires stratégiques, réunions d’équipe et moments de réflexion collective.

  • Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.

3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses

  • Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.

  • Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.

  • Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.

  • Veiller à ce que les décisions prises par la direction se traduisent concrètement en résultats.

4. Contribuer à la performance et à l’excellence opérationnelle

  • Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance de l’activité et identifier les axes d’amélioration.

  • Préparer des analyses et recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de la direction.

  • Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux processus et outils visant à améliorer l’efficacité collective.

  • Piloter des projets transverses à l’échelle de Theodo France, selon les priorités identifiées par la direction.

  • Faciliter la collaboration entre les différentes équipes et entités pour accélérer l’exécution des projets.

Tes perspectives

En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.

Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.

Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.

À terme, cette expérience pourra ouvrir la voie à des fonctions de direction opérationnelle, de direction de business unit ou à d’autres rôles de leadership au sein d’un environnement entrepreneurial.

Profil recherché

  • Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience significative en conseil en stratégie, en organisation ou en transformation.

  • Tu possèdes un excellent esprit analytique et sais structurer des problématiques complexes pour en tirer des recommandations concrètes.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément, sans perdre de vue les priorités.

  • Tu es un(e) véritable doer : tu sais passer de la réflexion à l’action et obtenir des résultats concrets.

  • Tu disposes d’un excellent relationnel et sais interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment des membres de la direction.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour challenger les idées, formuler des recommandations et faire avancer les décisions.

  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de proactivité et d’un fort sens des responsabilités.

  • Tu apprécies les environnements exigeants, dynamiques et entrepreneuriaux, dans lesquels les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement.

Ce qui fera la différence : ta capacité à combiner hauteur de vue stratégique, rigueur d’exécution et intelligence relationnelle pour transformer les ambitions de Theodo France en résultats tangibles.

What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 
 
The Role
 
As a Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own revenue generation within our key account level customer segment, focusing on winning high-value, strategic new-business opportunities. You will engage with senior stakeholders, navigate complex sales cycles, and create tailored value propositions that showcase how INFINIT’s AI-driven fintech platform transforms business operations.
 
We are looking for a high-performing hunter with a strong track record of closing larger deals, managing multi-stakeholder relationships, and driving high-impact commercial outcomes.

What do we want to achieve together?
  • You will own the full key account sales cycle, from strategic prospecting to negotiation and closing, with a primary focus on acquiring large, high-value customers particularly automotive clients such as car dealerships
  • You will act as a catalyst for innovation in large-account acquisition, identifying new growth opportunities and emerging verticals, particularly within the dealership ecosystem.
  • You will design and execute outbound strategies tailored to key account leads, with an emphasis on automotive dealership prospects.
  • You will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers within key account prospects understanding their unique operational needs and aligning them with INFINIT’s solutions.
  • You will collaborate closely with Product, and Customer Success teams to deliver seamless and impactful customer journeys for dealership clients.
  • You will drive commercial strategy and contribute to refining our value proposition for the automotive segment and other large verticals.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

You'll join the Security team under the CSO. You will lead Ledger's security risk governance and assurance, emphasise our answers to institutional customers' security requirements, and the evidence that our controls work.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Be the customer-facing voice of Ledger's risk and assurance position: due diligence, audits, contract security reviews and calls with customer security and risk teams.

  • Run enterprise security risk governance, the quality of the risk register and the records of risk acceptance.

  • Manage the ISO 27001 programme and prepare SOC 2 readiness.

  • Translate the legal requirements identified by Legal, including DORA, MiCA and NIS2, into security controls and evidence.

  • Govern third-party assurance and assess or coordinate the assessment of controls.

  • Provide independent challenge of security controls, and report to the Risk Committee.

  • Build and lead the GRC and assurance team, and own its strategy, roadmap and budget, including audit firms and assessors.

 

What we’re looking for:

data.title: Stage R&D Hardware - Banc de test multi-produits
data.description:
🚲Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données.

Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition.

Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !

🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.

🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).

Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :

Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22)

Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.

Le défi : router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation.

Tu utiliseras Claude (IA) au quotidien pour t’aider dans la conception, le développement et la documentation.

 

✏️Tes rôles :

– Recenser les besoins de test des produits (interfaces, séquences, mesures) et définir l’architecture du banc

– Concevoir la carte de pilotage (schéma, routage, mise au point) : commutation des bus, déconnexion physique des équipements, alimentation et mesure de consommation (précision, calibration, asservissement)

– Développer son firmware et le protocole de communication avec le poste central

– Développer le logiciel de supervision qui pilote chaque carte et déroule les scénarios de test

– Intégrer le banc à notre chaîne CI/CD (Jenkins, Git) pour lancer les tests automatiquement

– Valider le banc sur les produits, documenter et le mettre en service

Le poste est basé à Lannion, Bretagne, au sein d’une technopole à taille humaine d’envergure mondiale (1er centre R&D Orange Labs en France et 2ème site Nokia français). Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose

Ce que l’on te met à disposition :

  • Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents

  • Une équipe de passionnés qui travaillera à tes côtés


👉Et si c’était toi ?

– Bac+5, école d’ingénieur ou master en électronique / systèmes embarqués

– Électronique numérique : bus UART, I2C, JTAG, conception de cartes

– Firmware embarqué en C sur microcontrôleur

– Bases en mesure de courant, alimentation et asservissement

– Python pour la supervision et l’automatisation des tests, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins)

– Curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), à l’aise en laboratoire

L’entreprise et le projet te plaisent ?

« il ne faut jamais remettre au lendemain ce qu'on peut faire le jour-même » : Tu n’es pas arrivé.e jusqu’ici pour postuler « plus tard » ! C’est rapide, ça prend 2 minutes (et c’est vrai !)

❓Et après ?

Voici ce qu’il se passera si ton parcours nous semble pouvoir correspondre aux missions que nous proposons:

  • Premier échange téléphonique avec notre Chargée de recrutement Océane qui permet de confirmer les premiers prérequis et de conforter ton intérêt.

  • Un entretien avec le responsable du stage

  • Un retour personnalisé sur ta candidature

We’re looking for a Lead Deployment Engineer who will take charge of scaling our deployment activities across Europe. This is a role for someone who thrives both hands-on in the field and in leading and coordinating multiple deployments as we roll out robots at customer sites. You’ll shape how our robots are brought into production environments, ensuring smooth installations, happy customers, and continuous improvements that set new standards in logistics automation.

Who you are

  • Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early growth phase and own the deployment function end-to-end.

  • Experienced in logistics automation, with a proven track record of rolling out complex robotic or automation systems in production environments.

  • A leader who balances hands-on problem-solving with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Clear communicator, fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • Excited about frequent travel to customer sites across Europe (up to 50%).

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience in designing, testing, deploying and commissioning automation, robotics, or other machinery in industrial settings.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

Tasks

  • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

  • Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Benefits

  • Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo

  • Employee stock options: you own part of what you build

  • New office in Zürich Kreis 5

  • Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster

  • Work directly with the founders

data.title: Product Frontend Engineer
data.description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You have built complex software systems - and now want to build and lead the team behind them?

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. We are looking for an exceptional Software Team Lead who combines deep software understanding with the ability to understand user needs, develop people, and turn company priorities into coordinated execution.

Our software team works across infrastructure, cybersecurity, remote drone updates and fleet management, ground station applications, launch box software, and radio unit integration. Working with the CTO, Head of Engineering, and other team leads, you will shape the software roadmap and align commitments with company milestones. data.title: Senior Financial Controller
data.description:
About the role

As SkyNRG grows, so does the complexity of our finance activities. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Financial Controller who combines strong financial control expertise with a commercially-minded approach.

You will take ownership of financial control and reporting across key entities, projects and commercial activities. Working closely with various departments; Finance, Commercial, Legal, Operations and Project Development, you provide financial oversight and help ensure our project and commercial activities are financially well-managed.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Financial control & reporting: Own accounting and reporting activities, including complex accounting analysis, month- and year-end closing, balance sheet control and management reporting.

  • Planning & insights: Support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning and scenario analysis, translating results into meaningful business insights.

  • Business & project partnering: Support strategic projects and commercial agreements through financial modelling, analysis and constructive financial challenge.

  • Subsidies & compliance: Coordinate subsidy and grant reporting and support statutory and group audits.

  • Finance improvement: Help build scalable processes, controls and reporting structures and contribute to ERP, automation and finance transformation initiatives.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Economics or a related field, with 7+ years of relevant finance experience.

  • Strong experience in financial control, accounting, and reporting, including budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.

  • Experience analyzing complex accounting topics under Dutch GAAP and developing clear, well-supported accounting conclusions.

  • Experience working with projects or commercial agreements and translating these into financial models, insights and controls.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on complex financial topics.

  • Confident communicator who can collaborate with and constructively challenge both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

  • Advanced Excel skills, experience with ERP systems and fluency in English.

  • Hands-on, proactive and organised, with a strong sense of ownership.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience within a Big Four or similar audit environment.

  • Experience in energy, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing or other project-driven environments.

  • Experience with ERP implementations or finance transformation projects.

  • Knowledge of Dutch accounting and reporting requirements.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.
